Container.Name: spamfilter-rspamd
Container.Overview: rspamd scanner for the IMAP spam filter stack. Reads its `local.d` config from the mounted appdata directory, renders the controller password from $RSPAMD_PASSWORD at startup (envsubst), and listens on 11333 (scan) and 11334 (control + web UI).
Container.PostArgs: -c "set -e; mkdir -p /etc/rspamd/local.d; cp -a /etc/rspamd/local.d.src/. /etc/rspamd/local.d/; [ -n \"$RSPAMD_PASSWORD\" ] || { echo RSPAMD_PASSWORD empty; exit 1; }; envsubst < /etc/rspamd/local.d/worker-controller.inc.template > /etc/rspamd/local.d/worker-controller.inc; rm -f /etc/rspamd/local.d/worker-controller.inc.template; exec /docker-entrypoint.sh rspamd"
Container.Requires: Custom network `spamnet` must exist: `docker network create spamnet`. spamfilter-redis and spamfilter-unbound must be running.

Config.Name: Controller UI
Config.Description: rspamd controller HTTP (UI + /learn endpoints). Bind only to LAN or 127.0.0.1.

Config.Name: local.d configs
Config.Description: Copy this repo's rspamd/local.d/* into this directory before first start.

Config.Name: rspamd state
Config.Description: rspamd-managed runtime state (caches). Does not need backup.

Config.Name: RSPAMD_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Long random string. Use the SAME value here and on the spamfilter container. Suggestion: openssl rand -base64 48
